posts.subject: RoyalFapp...
posts.bodyHtml:
Wow [wow] wow... I completely apologise about RoyalFapp. I am extremely disappointed in him and will have the account password changed and taken away from him. RoyalFapp is an account that I made and use to play with my little cousin on. I did recently give my friend the account details for him to come and play with me on. I once brought him onto the knife server and played with him there for a while.


Firstly I came on today and was bombarded with messages from RoyalFapp saying he was banned from the knife server. I ask him why and he says that he "apparently" was rude a disrespected admins. I go to Sourcebans to check and see that it was true.


A bit later, I come on and go to come on the server and am told that I am banned from this server. I go onto Sourcebans and see that I am banned because "[SourceSleuth] Duplicate account". Obviously because I have used the account on my pc to play with my cousin in competitive mm. I guess it tracked the ip to here and banned me because I have logged in on here? Either way, is there a way to get unbanned? I have tried several times.


I'd just like to reassure you that my friend will no longer be playing on this account and I will talk to him about this. Sorry for all the problems he has made. I honestly had no idea he would act like this and it won't happen again.


The one thing I'm worried about is my account and how we will have to go about having it unbanned? Thanks for reading and again, I'm sorry about everything that RoyalFapp has done today.


Would also like to add that I am extremely annoyed with everything he has done. Not only has he got me banned from the knife server but also got the account VAC'd. Will be having serious words with him.
@Nachtfrische @OxygeN @Hypnoxas

No you get banned if the Ips match, that means you played with that account on Dream Servers at that moment the account got banned. I'm disappointed that you have to lie and say that it was one of your friends.

Hello Raven,


Well I have been ashamed in whoever used the account RoyalFapp and can assure you the ban will not be lifted due to appalling behavior which he has show on server and in the shoutbox where I can get @ApudoX, @CyberTroniX, @Hypnoxas to confirm this which made me raise his ban up to a week.
Now moving onto your ban for duplicate account I have to say I'm ashamed in your "lying" if we can call this as SourceSleuth bans only when the ips match ( as stated by @ifZ4ne) and in this case the Ips have been matched so I have to say I can see some fishy parts in this post, but as I said RoyalFapp's ban will not be lifted.


Kind Regards

Are you entirely that stupid? I have said already, I have used the account to play competitive with my cousin. I gave the details to my friend to play on. I played the account maybe once or twice, lasting up to no more than 25 minutes on dream. I brought my friend onto the knife server to play with me.


If you seriously think that I would even do anything like that to anyone, especially oxygen then you must have a problem. Oxygen is a very good friend and always has been since I met him. I have already spoken to my friend who was playing the account and he explained that he got frustrated with people 2vs1 ing...


Believe what you want to believe but I can assure you that I have not done anything of this sort and wouldn't want to ruin my friendships and worst of all loose my position as an admin. I understand how pathetic this must seem but I can't even believe you could think and try and say that this was me.

Well raven I understand you being lost in this situation and I trust you but It kinda seems weird that both ips are identical ( Not putting any opinion now ) but you should explain to your friend that he got reasonably banned for constant insults towards the players and his behavior in the shoutbox and saying "Mate you're a bad admin... FACE IT" is not ideal what he should say and his behavior lead him to a ban of a week which I decided already not to lift.
Hopefully this situation get's explained as I know raven for a bit and he is this type of guy you can trust but this situation surely needs to be looked in depth and hopefully raven will stay with us as part of a team.

Ya think? I know all this... I don't understand how it leads to my IP and or why but I can guarantee to everyone that I was not the one playing the account at the time.



I can't stress enough, Oxygen is one of my best mates on CS:GO and I would never do any of the stuff that it seems he did. I honestly am so confused how this has lead me to be the culprit...

With this "duplicate account" provocation happening, I would like to say that both these accounts have been on the knife server at the same time. I feel that this makes Raven's story feasible. This reminds me when my brother played on the knife server with his own account. And he sounded very alike to me due to being my twin. And this led to a specific party of people giving me abuse for having duplicate accounts, for which I didn't have. My point became very incredulous to support due to the fact that me and my brother used one PC as well as the difficulty to be able to prove my twin brother was real without releasing sensitive info about me.

Doesnt matter if both accounts are online at the same time, if one account get banned ingame the current ip will be logged in sourcebans. So if you connect with the same Internet connection, again at the same day, you will get duplicated account ban. That leads into that, Swifty did it himself. Just stay on point and dont talk pointless shit (nothing against you but that is so pointless @Fiddles). Also he stated that his friend messaged him, which means for me, his friend and swifty were in different locations, so it shouldnt be possible to have the same ip.
